# Seismic Record Selection {#sec-srs}

{{< include /_chapters/srs.model.md >}}

## Record Selection {#sec-srs_results}

### Selected Suite {#sec-srs_results_records}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(SelectionTable)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(SelectionTable))) {
    .knitSelectionBlock(
      path = "/_tbl/SRS.qmd",
      vars = list(CAP = readCaption("tbl.SRS")),
      stem = "srs-records",
      selections = SelectionTable,
      i = i,
      root = root,
      heading = SelectionTable$label[[i]],
      level = 4L,
      anchor = "sec-srs_records",
      context = "SRS chapter"
    )
  }
  rm(i)
}
```

### Target-Spectrum Compatibility {#sec-srs_results_psa}

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!is.null(SelectionTable)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(SelectionTable))) {
    if (!exists("CAPTION", inherits = FALSE)) {
      Site <- .reportLabel(envir = list2env(
        .reportSelection(SelectionTable, i, "srs-psa")$vars,
        parent = knitr::knit_global()
      ))
      Site <- if (nzchar(Site)) {
        sprintf(" at %s", Site)
      } else if (exists("params", inherits = FALSE) && !is.null(params$site)) {
        sprintf(" at %s", params$site)
      } else {
        ""
      }
      CAPTION <- sprintf(readCaption("fig.srs.psa"), Site)
      rm(Site)
    }
    .knitSelectionBlock(
      path = "/_fig/srs.psa.qmd",
      vars = list(CAPTION = CAPTION),
      stem = "srs-psa",
      selections = SelectionTable,
      i = i,
      root = root,
      heading = SelectionTable$label[[i]],
      level = 4L,
      anchor = "sec-srs_psa",
      context = "SRS chapter"
    )
    rm(CAPTION)
  }
  rm(i)
}
rm(list = intersect(c("SiteTable", "SelectionTable"), ls()))
```
